comparative-advantage-two-ppcs.alt: Two straight production possibilities lines for one worker a day: Arland, 40 bushels of wheat or 20 yards of cloth, and Belmar, 30 bushels of wheat or 10 yards of cloth, with the opportunity costs: cloth costs Arland 2 bushels and Belmar 3; wheat costs Arland half a yard and Belmar a third of a yard.
